Kashmirian polymath, surnamed Vyāsadāsa; son of Prakāśendra, a lavish patron of Brahmans, an. grandson of Sindhu an. descendent of Narendra, minister of King Jayāpīḍa; pupil of Abhinavagupta in Sāhitya an. D. eulogised in his Au. v. c., K. kaṇṭhābharaṇa Samayamātṛkā an. Suvṛttatilaka) an. his son an. successor Kalaśa (till 1088 A. D.) of Kashmir.
